```json
      "config": {
        "label": "Email",
        "description": "The email address of the contact.",
        "required": false,
        "settings": {
          "only_allow_single_entry": true
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

*Response*

```json
{
  "app_id": 1,
  "workspace_id": 1,
  "slug": "contacts",
  "external_id": "contacts",
  "name": "Contacts",
  "record_name": "Contact",
  "item_name": "Contact",
  "type": "database",
  "config": {
    "item_name": "Contact",
    "name": "Contacts"
  },
  "fields": [
    {
      "field_id": 1,
      "external_id": "name",
      "slug": "name",
      "label": "Name",
      "type": "text",
      "field_type": "single_text",
      "config": {
        "label": "Name",
        "slug": "name",
        "external_id": "name",
        "description": "The full name of the contact.",
        "show_description": true,
        "required": true,
        "always_hidden": false,
        "hidden_if_empty": false,
        "primary": true,
        "settings": {
          "formatted": false,
          "format": "plain"
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "field_id": 2,
      "external_id": "email",
      "slug": "email",
      "label": "Email",
      "type": "email",
      "field_type": "multi_email",
      "config": {
        "label": "Email",
        "slug": "email",
        "external_id": "email",
        "description": "The email address of the contact.",
        "show_description": true,
        "required": false,
        "always_hidden": false,
        "hidden_if_empty": false,
        "primary": false,
        "settings": {
          "only_allow_single_entry": true,
          "label_setting": "default"
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

The example changes the "Email" field (ID `2`) of the contacts app so that users can add only one email address in Tape.

Find the app ID and the field IDs in the [Developer view of the app](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/app#find-app-and-field-ids).

**General behavior**

-   A field with `field_id` updates that field. A field without `field_id` creates a new field and needs a `field_type`.
-   Without `only_allow_single_entry`, the setting stays as it is.
-   `only_allow_single_entry` changes only what users can do in Tape. Email addresses that a record already has stay.
-   Send `required`, `always_hidden`, `hidden_if_empty` and `description` with every field you update. Tape sets left-out switches to `false` and hides the help text without `description`. See [Create and update fields](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/overview#create-and-update-fields).
-   Fields that aren't in the request stay unchanged.

**Requirements:** `apps:edit`, and **Full access** to the app. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token or a user API key.

**Errors**

-   Every field you update needs `config.label`, even if the label stays the same. Without it, Tape rejects the request with `400` and `input_validation`. The message reads, for example, `Invalid input: data/fields/0/config must have required property 'label'`.

# Image field

> Use an image field to store photos and other images in a record.

Use an image field to store photos and other images in a record.

Tape has one image field type: `multi_image` is the **Image** field. It holds one or more images.

An image field has the [common field properties](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/overview#common-properties) and read-only `settings`. To read and write the images of a record, see [Image field value](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field-value/image).

*Image field object*

```json
{
  "field_id": 1,
  "external_id": "photos",
  "slug": "photos",
  "label": "Photos",
  "type": "file",
  "field_type": "multi_image",
  "config": {
    "label": "Photos",
    "slug": "photos",
    "external_id": "photos",
    "description": "Photos of the property.",
    "show_description": true,
    "required": false,
    "always_hidden": false,
    "hidden_if_empty": false,
    "primary": false,
    "settings": {
      "multiple": true
    }
  }
}
```

| Property | Type | Description | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `string` | `"file"` for the image field. | `"file"` |
| `field_type` | `string` | `"multi_image"`. | `"multi_image"` |
| `config.settings.multiple` (read-only) | `boolean` | `true`. | `true` |

You can't set `settings` through the API.

# Link field

> Use a link field to store one or more web addresses in a record, such as a company website or social profiles.

Use a link field to store one or more web addresses in a record, such as a company website or social profiles.

Tape has one link field type: `multi_link` is the **Link** field. It holds one or more links. Tape adds a preview with title and description to each link.

A link field has the [common field properties](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/overview#common-properties) and read-only `settings`. To read and write the links of a record, see [Link field value](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field-value/link).

*Link field object*

```json
{
  "field_id": 2,
  "external_id": "website",
  "slug": "website",
  "label": "Website",
  "type": "embed",
  "field_type": "multi_link",
  "config": {
    "label": "Website",
    "slug": "website",
    "external_id": "website",
    "description": "The website and social profiles of the company.",
    "show_description": true,
    "required": false,
    "always_hidden": false,
    "hidden_if_empty": false,
    "primary": false,
    "settings": {
      "label_setting": "default"
    }
  }
}
```

| Property | Type | Description | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `string` | `"embed"` for a link field. | `"embed"` |
| `field_type` | `string` | `"multi_link"`. | `"multi_link"` |
| `config.settings.label_setting` (read-only) | `string` | Which type labels the field offers: `"default"` (all built-in labels), `"url"` (`homepage`, `work`, `home`, `other`), `"social_profile"` (`linkedin`, `x`, `instagram`, `facebook`, `youtube`, `tiktok`, `threads`, `reddit`, `bluesky`, `other`), `"custom_only"` (only the field's own labels) or `"none"`. With `"none"`, Tape ignores a `type` you send with a field value. | `"default"` |

You can't set `settings` through the API. Choose the labels of a link field in Tape.

```json
        "always_hidden": false,
        "hidden_if_empty": false,
        "primary": true,
        "settings": {
          "formatted": false,
          "format": "plain"
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "field_id": 2,
      "external_id": "website",
      "slug": "website",
      "label": "Web profiles",
      "type": "embed",
      "field_type": "multi_link",
      "config": {
        "label": "Web profiles",
        "slug": "website",
        "external_id": "website",
        "description": "The website and social profiles of the company.",
        "show_description": true,
        "required": false,
        "always_hidden": false,
        "hidden_if_empty": false,
        "primary": false,
        "settings": {
          "label_setting": "default"
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

The example renames the "Website" field (ID `2`) of the companies app to "Web profiles".

Find the app ID and the field IDs in the [Developer view of the app](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/app#find-app-and-field-ids).

**General behavior**

-   A field with `field_id` updates that field. A field without `field_id` creates a new field and needs a `field_type`.
-   Renaming a field keeps its `slug`. The renamed field "Web profiles" still has the slug `website`.
-   Send `required`, `always_hidden`, `hidden_if_empty` and `description` with every field you update. Tape sets left-out switches to `false` and hides the help text without `description`. See [Create and update fields](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/overview#create-and-update-fields).
-   Fields that aren't in the request stay unchanged.

**Requirements:** `apps:edit`, and **Full access** to the app. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token or a user API key.

**Errors**

-   Every field you update needs `config.label`, even if the label stays the same. Without it, Tape rejects the request with `400` and `input_validation`. The message reads, for example, `Invalid input: data/fields/0/config must have required property 'label'`.

# Location field

> Use a location field to store an address in a record, such as the address of a property or a solar site.

Use a location field to store an address in a record, such as the address of a property or a solar site.

Tape has one location field type: `single_location` is the **Location** field. It holds one address with its parts and, if you add them, its coordinates.

A location field has the [common field properties](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/overview#common-properties) and its own `settings`. To read and write the address of a record, see [Location field value](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field-value/location).

*Location field object*

```json
{
  "field_id": 2,
  "external_id": "address",
  "slug": "address",
  "label": "Address",
  "type": "location",
  "field_type": "single_location",
  "config": {
    "label": "Address",
    "slug": "address",
    "external_id": "address",
    "description": "The address of the property.",
    "show_description": true,
    "required": false,
    "always_hidden": false,
    "hidden_if_empty": false,
    "primary": false,
    "settings": {
      "has_map": true
    }
  }
}
```

| Property | Type | Description | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `string` | `"location"` for a location field. | `"location"` |
| `field_type` | `string` | `"single_location"`. | `"single_location"` |
| `config.settings.has_map` | `boolean` | If `true`, Tape shows a map with the address in the record. Default: `false`. | `true` |

The map needs coordinates. Tape doesn't look them up for an address from the API. Send `latitude` and `longitude` with the [field value](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field-value/location#record-creation).

**General behavior**

-   Without `has_map`, the field shows no map.
-   Without `primary`, Tape makes the first field of the request the primary field. Here, that's "Name".
-   A new location field doesn't show its `description` as help text yet (`show_description` is `false`). To show it, send the `description` again in a field update.

**Requirements:** `apps:edit`, and a workspace role that may edit apps in the workspace. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token or a user API key.

# Created and last edited fields

> Use these field types to show when a record was created or last edited, and by whom.

Use these field types to show when a record was created or last edited, and by whom.

> Looking for a Podio field type?
> 
> Tape has no `money`, `duration` or `progress` field type. Use a `number` field. See [Podio field types](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/overview#podio-field-types).

| `field_type` | Field in Tape | `type` | `settings` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `created_on` | **Created on** | `created_at` | `show_time` (`boolean`): whether Tape shows the time next to the date |
| `created_by` | **Created by** | `created_by` | none |
| `last_modified_on` | **Last edited on** | `last_modified_at` | `show_time` (`boolean`): whether Tape shows the time next to the date |
| `last_modified_by` | **Last edited by** | `last_modified_by` | none |

Create and update these fields with the [create app endpoint](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/app#create-an-app) and the [update app endpoint](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/app#update-an-app), like the other field types. They have the [common field properties](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/overview#common-properties).

The example adds a "Created on" field that shows the time to an existing app. Find the app ID in the [Developer view of the app](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/app#find-app-and-field-ids).

`PUT https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/app/{appId}`

*Request*

```json
{
  "fields": [
    {
      "field_type": "created_on",
      "config": {
        "label": "Created on",
        "settings": { "show_time": true }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

**General behavior**

-   Tape fills the values of these fields. You can't write them.
-   Field updates follow the rules in [Create and update fields](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/overview#create-and-update-fields).
-   A record response doesn't list these values in `fields`. Read them from the record properties `created_on`, `created_by`, `last_modified_on` and `last_modified_by`.

**Requirements:** `apps:edit`, and **Full access** to the app. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token or a user API key.

# Number field

> Use a number field to store an amount, a quantity or any other number in a record.

Use a number field to store an amount, a quantity or any other number in a record.

Tape has one number field type: `number` is the **Number** field. It holds one number per record.

A number field has the [common field properties](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/overview#common-properties) and the `settings` below. To read and write the number of a record, see [Number field value](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field-value/number).

*Number field object*

```json
{
  "field_id": 2,
  "external_id": "closing_amount",
  "slug": "closing_amount",
  "label": "Closing Amount",
  "type": "number",
  "field_type": "number",
  "config": {
    "label": "Closing Amount",
    "slug": "closing_amount",
    "external_id": "closing_amount",
    "description": "The amount of the deal.",
    "show_description": true,
    "required": false,
    "always_hidden": false,
    "hidden_if_empty": false,
    "primary": false,
    "settings": {
      "unit_location": "suffix",
      "decimals": 2,
      "unit_label": "€",
      "unit": "€"
    }
  }
}
```

| Property | Type | Description | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `string` | `"number"`. | `"number"` |
| `field_type` | `string` | `"number"`. | `"number"` |
| `config.settings.decimals` | `number` or `null` | Number of decimal places, from 0 to 8. `null` means automatic precision. A new field without `decimals` gets `0`. | `2` |
| `config.settings.unit` | `string` | Unit shown with the value, for example `"€"`, `"kg"` or `"kWh"`. | `"€"` |
| `config.settings.unit_location` | `string` | Where Tape shows the unit: `"prefix"` before the value, `"suffix"` after it. Without `unit_location`, Tape shows the unit before the value. Responses can show `"prefix_and_suffix"` for fields set up in Tape. `unit` then holds only the prefix. The API can't set a prefix and a suffix together. | `"suffix"` |
| `config.settings.unit_label` (read-only) | `string` | Same as `unit`, kept for backwards compatibility. | `"€"` |

```json
          "unit_label": "$",
          "unit": "$"
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

The example changes the "Closing Amount" field (ID `2`) of the deals app to US dollars. The unit becomes "$" and moves in front of the value. The "Deal Name" field isn't in the request, so it stays unchanged.

Find the app ID and the field IDs in the [Developer view of the app](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/app#find-app-and-field-ids).

**General behavior**

-   A field with `field_id` updates that field. A field without `field_id` creates a new field and needs a `field_type`.
-   Settings you leave out keep their values. Without `decimals`, the number of decimal places stays the same.
-   Changing `decimals` to a number rounds the stored values of the field to that number of decimal places. Changing it to `null` keeps the stored values as they are.
-   Changing `unit` or `unit_location` changes only how Tape shows the values.
-   Send `required`, `always_hidden`, `hidden_if_empty` and `description` with every field you update. Tape sets left-out switches to `false` and hides the help text without `description`. See [Create and update fields](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/overview#create-and-update-fields).
-   Fields that aren't in the request stay unchanged.

**Requirements:** `apps:edit`, and **Full access** to the app. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token or a user API key.

**Errors**

-   Every field you update needs `config.label`, even if the label stays the same. Without it, Tape rejects the request with `400` and `input_validation`. The message reads, for example, `Invalid input: data/fields/0/config must have required property 'label'`.
-   `decimals` below 0 or above 8 returns `400`.

# Field

> Use fields to define the structure of the records of a database app.

Use fields to define the structure of the records of a database app.

A field belongs to one app. A field is the definition: its name, type and settings. A field value is what one record holds for that field, see [Field value](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field-value/overview).

A "Contacts" app could have the fields "First Name" (**Single line text**), "Last Name" (**Single line text**) and "Phone" (**Phone**). Every record then has values for these fields.

You create, update and delete fields through the app endpoints, see [Create and update fields](#create-and-update-fields). Responses that return a full app also return its fields.

*Field object*

```json
{
  "field_id": 2,
  "external_id": "notes",
  "slug": "notes",
  "label": "Notes",
  "type": "text",
  "field_type": "multi_text",
  "config": {
    "label": "Notes",
    "slug": "notes",
    "external_id": "notes",
    "description": "Notes about the contact.",
    "show_description": true,
    "required": false,
    "always_hidden": false,
    "hidden_if_empty": false,
    "primary": false,
    "settings": {
      "formatted": true,
      "format": "html"
    }
  }
}
```

## Common properties

All field types share these properties:

| Property | Type | Description | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `field_id` | `number` | ID of the field. | `2` |
| `slug` | `string` | Identifier of the field within its app. Tape creates it from the label when you create the field. Renaming the field keeps the slug. Use the field ID or the slug as the key of a field value in record requests. Records return the slug as `external_id`. | `"notes"` |
| `external_id` | `string` | Deprecated. Same as `slug`, kept for backwards compatibility. Use `slug`. | `"notes"` |
| `label` | `string` | Name of the field in Tape. | `"Notes"` |
| `type` | `string` | Kind of data the field holds. See [Field type](#field-type). | `"text"` |
| `field_type` | `string` | Exact type of the field. See [Field type](#field-type). | `"multi_text"` |
| `config.label` | `string` | Name of the field. Required when you create or update a field. | `"Notes"` |
| `config.slug` | `string` | Same as `slug`. | `"notes"` |
| `config.external_id` | `string` | Deprecated. Same as `slug`, kept for backwards compatibility. Use `slug`. | `"notes"` |
| `config.description` | `string` | Help text of the field. | `"Notes about the contact."` |
| `config.show_description` (read-only) | `boolean` | Whether Tape shows the `description` as help text inside the record. | `true` |
| `config.required` | `boolean` | Whether a record needs a value for this field. You can still clear `single_text`, `number`, relation, checklist, email, link and phone fields in an update. | `false` |
| `config.hidden_if_empty` | `boolean` | Whether Tape hides the field inside the record when it has no value. | `false` |
| `config.always_hidden` | `boolean` | Whether Tape hides the field inside the record, even when it has a value. | `false` |
| `config.primary` | `boolean` | Whether the field is the primary field of the app. The value of the primary field names a record wherever Tape refers to it. Any field type can be the primary field. An app has at most one primary field, and some apps have none. | `false` |
| `config.settings` | `object` | Settings of the field type. The structure depends on `field_type`. See the page of each field type. | `{ "formatted": true, "format": "html" }` |

## Field type

Each field has a `field_type` and a `type`. The `field_type` is the exact type of the field. The `type` is the kind of data it holds, so several field types share one `type`.

For field types that can hold one value or several values, the prefix of the `field_type` says which: `single_category` holds one option, `multi_category` holds several.

A `single_category` field value never has more than one option. Switching a field from `single_category` to `multi_category` converts the field and all its values.

| `field_type` | Field in Tape | `type` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`single_text`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/text) | **Single line text** | `text` |
| [`multi_text`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/text) | **Multi line text** | `text` |
| [`single_category`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/category) | **Single select** | `category` |
| [`multi_category`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/category) | **Multiple select** | `category` |
| [`status`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/status) | **Status** | `category` |
| [`single_date`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/date) | **Date** | `date` |
| [`range_date`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/date) | **Date** with an end date | `date` |
| [`number`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/number) | **Number** | `number` |
| [`calculation`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/calculation) | **Calculation** | `calculation` |
| [`single_relation`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/relation) | **Relation** to one record | `app` |
| [`multi_relation`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/relation) | **Relation** to several records | `app` |
| [`single_user`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/user) | **Member**, one member | `contact` |
| [`multi_user`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/user) | **Member**, several members | `contact` |
| [`single_attachment`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/attachment) | **Files**, one file | `file` |
| [`multi_attachment`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/attachment) | **Files**, several files | `file` |
| [`multi_image`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/image) | **Image** | `file` |
| [`multi_email`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/email) | **Email** | `email` |
| [`multi_phone`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/phone) | **Phone** | `phone` |
| [`multi_link`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/link) | **Link** | `embed` |
| [`checklist`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/checklist) | **Task list** | `checklist` |
| [`single_location`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/location) | **Location** | `location` |
| [`unique_id`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/unique-id) | **Unique ID** | `unique_id` |
| [`created_on`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/missing-types) | **Created on** | `created_at` |
| [`created_by`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/missing-types) | **Created by** | `created_by` |
| [`last_modified_on`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/missing-types) | **Last edited on** | `last_modified_at` |
| [`last_modified_by`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/missing-types) | **Last edited by** | `last_modified_by` |

When you create a field, send one of these values as `field_type`. Tape rejects any other value with `400`.

Tape fills `calculation`, `unique_id`, `created_on`, `created_by`, `last_modified_on` and `last_modified_by` fields. You can create and configure these fields, but you can't write their values.

### Podio field types

Find the Tape field type for each Podio field type. The Podio `external_id` of a field is the `slug` in Tape.

| Podio field type | Tape `field_type` | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | [`single_text`, `multi_text`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/text) | `multi_text` holds rich text (HTML). |
| `number` | [`number`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/number) |  |
| `money` | [`number`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/number) | No money type. The currency is the field's `unit`, not part of the value. |
| `duration` | [`number`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/number) | No duration type. Store the duration as a number, for example in seconds. |
| `progress` | [`number`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/number) | No progress type. Store 0 to 100, for example with the unit `%`. |
| `category` | [`single_category`, `multi_category`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/category), [`status`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/status) |  |
| `date` | [`single_date`, `range_date`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/date) |  |
| `contact` | [`single_user`, `multi_user`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/user) | Users of your organization only, guests included. Keep external contacts without a Tape account as records and link them with a relation field. |
| `app` (app reference) | [`single_relation`, `multi_relation`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/relation) |  |
| `image` | [`multi_image`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/image) |  |
| `embed` | [`multi_link`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/link) |  |
| `location` | [`single_location`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/location) |  |
| `calculation` | [`calculation`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/calculation) | Read-only. |
| `phone` (`tel`) | [`multi_phone`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/phone) |  |
| `email` | [`multi_email`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/email) |  |
| Files of an item | [`single_attachment`, `multi_attachment`](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/attachment) | A record has no file list of its own. Add an attachment field. |

The `type` keeps the Podio names `app`, `contact` and `embed`. New in Tape: `status`, `checklist`, `unique_id` and the fields for creation and last edit.

## Create and update fields

Use the [create app endpoint](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/app#create-an-app) to create fields together with a new app. Use the [update app endpoint](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/app#update-an-app) to create new fields in an app, change existing fields or delete fields with `fields_to_delete`. The page of each field type has a full example.

Find the workspace ID, the app ID and the field IDs in the [Developer view of the app](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/app#find-app-and-field-ids).

To change the order of the fields, use [Update an app's field order](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/app#update-an-apps-field-order).

**General behavior**

-   A field with `field_id` updates that field. A field without `field_id` creates a new field and needs a `field_type`.
-   Every field you update needs `config.label`, even if the label stays the same.
-   Send `required`, `always_hidden` and `hidden_if_empty` with every field update. Tape sets the ones you leave out to `false`. A **Status** field is the exception: without `required`, it stays required.
-   A new `single_text` or `multi_text` field with a `description` shows it as help text. A new field of another type starts with `show_description` set to `false`.
-   Send `description` with every field update to show the help text or keep it visible. Without `description`, Tape sets `show_description` to `false`. **Single select**, **Multiple select** and **Status** fields keep their `show_description` as it is in both cases.
-   To change one property, read the field first with [Retrieve a single app](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/app#retrieve-a-single-app) and send back what you keep. A relation field without `settings` loses its linked apps.
-   Without `primary`, Tape makes the first field of a new app the primary field. It skips `unique_id`, `created_on`, `created_by`, `last_modified_on` and `last_modified_by` fields, unless the request has only fields of these types. Adding fields to an app that has fields leaves its primary field unchanged.
-   Set `primary` to `true` to make a field the primary field. The field that was the primary field before loses the role. In a field update, leaving out `primary` keeps the primary field as it is.
-   Fields that aren't in the request stay unchanged.

**Requirements:** `apps:edit`. Creating an app needs a workspace role that may edit apps in the workspace, updating one needs **Full access** to the app. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token or a user API key.

**Errors**

-   A field update without `config.label` returns `400` with `input_validation` and a message such as `Invalid input: data/fields/0/config must have required property 'label'`.
-   A field update without `config` returns `400` with `validation`.
-   A request that sets `primary` to `true` on more than one field returns `400`.
-   A field update that sets `primary` to `false` on the primary field, without a new primary field, returns `400`. An app with a primary field keeps one.

# Phone field

> Use a phone field to store one or more phone numbers in a record.

Use a phone field to store one or more phone numbers in a record.

Tape has one phone field type: `multi_phone` is the **Phone** field. It holds one or more phone numbers, each with a type label such as `mobile` or `work`.

A phone field has the [common field properties](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/overview#common-properties) and its own `settings`. To read and write the phone numbers of a record, see [Phone field value](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field-value/phone).

*Phone field object*

```json
{
  "field_id": 3,
  "external_id": "phone",
  "slug": "phone",
  "label": "Phone",
  "type": "phone",
  "field_type": "multi_phone",
  "config": {
    "label": "Phone",
    "slug": "phone",
    "external_id": "phone",
    "description": "The phone numbers of the lead.",
    "show_description": true,
    "required": false,
    "always_hidden": false,
    "hidden_if_empty": false,
    "primary": false,
    "settings": {
      "call_link_scheme": "tel",
      "only_allow_single_entry": false,
      "label_setting": "default"
    }
  }
}
```

| Property | Type | Description | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `string` | `"phone"` for a phone field. | `"phone"` |
| `field_type` | `string` | `"multi_phone"`. | `"multi_phone"` |
| `config.settings.call_link_scheme` | `string` | The link Tape opens when users select a phone number: `"tel"` or `"callto"`. Default: `"tel"`. | `"tel"` |
| `config.settings.only_allow_single_entry` | `boolean` | If `true`, users can add only one phone number in Tape. The API still accepts more than one. Default: `false`. | `false` |
| `config.settings.label_setting` (read-only) | `string` | Which type labels the field offers: `"default"` (`mobile`, `work`, `home`, `main`, `other`), `"extended"` (adds `work_fax`, `home_fax` and `pager`), `"custom_only"` (only the field's own labels) or `"none"`. With `"none"`, Tape ignores a `type` you send with a field value. | `"default"` |

You can't set `label_setting` through the API. Choose the labels of a phone field in Tape.

![Settings of a Phone field with the choice of type labels](https://developers.tapeapp.com/assets/images/phone-labels-481bfc8961108737ffc31ef80be097e9.png)

## App creation

Use the [create app endpoint](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/app#create-an-app) to create phone fields together with a new app.

`POST https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/app`

**cURL**

*Request*

```shell

curl -X POST https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/app/ \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TAPE_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{
    "workspace_id": 1,
    "name": "Leads",
    "item_name": "Lead",
    "fields": [
      {
        "field_type": "single_text",
        "config": {
          "label": "Name",
          "description": "The full name of the lead.",
          "required": true
        }
      },
      {
        "field_type": "multi_phone",
        "config": {
          "label": "Phone",
          "description": "The phone numbers of the lead.",
          "required": false,
          "settings": {
            "only_allow_single_entry": false,
            "call_link_scheme": "tel"
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  }'
```

**JSON**

*Request*

```json
{
  "workspace_id": 1,
  "name": "Leads",
  "item_name": "Lead",
  "fields": [
    {
      "field_type": "single_text",
      "config": {
        "label": "Name",
        "description": "The full name of the lead.",
        "required": true
      }
    },
    {
      "field_type": "multi_phone",
      "config": {
        "label": "Phone",
        "description": "The phone numbers of the lead.",
        "required": false,
        "settings": {
          "only_allow_single_entry": false,
          "call_link_scheme": "tel"
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

*Response*

```json
{
  "app_id": 1,
  "workspace_id": 1,
  "slug": "leads",
  "external_id": "leads",
  "name": "Leads",
  "record_name": "Lead",
  "item_name": "Lead",
  "type": "database",
  "config": {
    "item_name": "Lead",
    "name": "Leads"
  },
  "fields": [
    {
      "field_id": 1,
      "external_id": "name",
      "slug": "name",
      "label": "Name",
      "type": "text",
      "field_type": "single_text",
      "config": {
        "label": "Name",
        "slug": "name",
        "external_id": "name",
        "description": "The full name of the lead.",
        "show_description": true,
        "required": true,
        "always_hidden": false,
        "hidden_if_empty": false,
        "primary": true,
        "settings": {
          "formatted": false,
          "format": "plain"
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "field_id": 3,
      "external_id": "phone",
      "slug": "phone",
      "label": "Phone",
      "type": "phone",
      "field_type": "multi_phone",
      "config": {
        "label": "Phone",
        "slug": "phone",
        "external_id": "phone",
        "description": "The phone numbers of the lead.",
        "show_description": false,
        "required": false,
        "always_hidden": false,
        "hidden_if_empty": false,
        "primary": false,
        "settings": {
          "call_link_scheme": "tel",
          "only_allow_single_entry": false,
          "label_setting": "default"
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

The example creates a leads app in the workspace with ID `1`. The app gets a `single_text` field "Name" and a `multi_phone` field "Phone".

Find the workspace ID with [Retrieve workspaces](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/workspace#retrieve-workspaces).

**General behavior**

-   Without `call_link_scheme`, the field uses `"tel"`. Without `only_allow_single_entry`, it's `false`.
-   A new phone field offers the default labels (`"label_setting": "default"`).
-   Without `primary`, Tape makes the first field of the request the primary field. Here, that's "Name".
-   A new phone field doesn't show its `description` as help text yet (`show_description` is `false`). To show it, send the `description` again in a field update.

**Requirements:** `apps:edit`, and a workspace role that may edit apps in the workspace. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token or a user API key.

**Errors**

-   A `call_link_scheme` other than `"tel"` or `"callto"` returns `400`.

```json
          "call_link_scheme": "callto",
          "only_allow_single_entry": false,
          "label_setting": "default"
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

The example changes the call link of the "Phone" field (ID `3`) of the leads app to `callto`.

Find the app ID and the field IDs in the [Developer view of the app](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/app#find-app-and-field-ids).

**General behavior**

-   A field with `field_id` updates that field. A field without `field_id` creates a new field and needs a `field_type`.
-   Send `call_link_scheme` with every update of a phone field. Without it, Tape sets the call link back to `"tel"`.
-   Without `only_allow_single_entry`, the setting stays as it is.
-   Send `required`, `always_hidden`, `hidden_if_empty` and `description` with every field you update. Tape sets left-out switches to `false` and hides the help text without `description`. See [Create and update fields](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/overview#create-and-update-fields).
-   Fields that aren't in the request stay unchanged.

**Requirements:** `apps:edit`, and **Full access** to the app. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token or a user API key.

**Errors**

-   Every field you update needs `config.label`, even if the label stays the same. Without it, Tape rejects the request with `400` and `input_validation`. The message reads, for example, `Invalid input: data/fields/0/config must have required property 'label'`.
-   A `call_link_scheme` other than `"tel"` or `"callto"` returns `400`.

# Relation field

> Use a relation field to link a record to records of other database apps.

Use a relation field to link a record to records of other database apps.

Tape has two relation field types. Both are the **Relation** field in Tape:

-   `single_relation` holds one related record.
-   `multi_relation` holds several related records.

A relation field has the [common field properties](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/overview#common-properties) and `settings` with the apps it can link to. To read and write the related records of a record, see [Relation field value](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field-value/relation).

*Relation field object*

```json
{
  "field_id": 1,
  "external_id": "belongs_to_epic",
  "slug": "belongs_to_epic",
  "label": "Belongs to Epic",
  "type": "app",
  "field_type": "single_relation",
  "config": {
    "label": "Belongs to Epic",
    "slug": "belongs_to_epic",
    "external_id": "belongs_to_epic",
    "description": "The epic this issue belongs to.",
    "show_description": true,
    "required": true,
    "always_hidden": false,
    "hidden_if_empty": false,
    "primary": false,
    "settings": {
      "multiple": false,
      "referenced_apps": [
        {
          "app_id": 2,
          "app": {
            "app_id": 2,
            "icon": "event_available",
            "name": "Epics",
            "slug": "epics",
            "external_id": "epics",
            "record_name": "Epic",
            "item_name": "Epic",
            "workspace_id": 1,
            "config": {
              "name": "Epics",
              "icon": "event_available",
              "record_name": "Epic",
              "workspace_id": 1
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

| Property | Type | Description | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `string` | `"app"` for both relation field types. | `"app"` |
| `field_type` | `string` | `"single_relation"` or `"multi_relation"`. | `"single_relation"` |
| `config.settings.multiple` (read-only) | `boolean` | `false` for `single_relation`, `true` for `multi_relation`. | `false` |
| `config.settings.referenced_apps` | `array` | The apps whose records the field can link to. |  |
| `config.settings.referenced_apps[].app_id` | `number` | ID of a linked app. Required when you create or change the field. See [Where do I find the app ID?](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/app#find-app-and-field-ids). | `2` |
| `config.settings.referenced_apps[].view_id` | `number` | ID of a view of the linked app. Its filters limit the records you can select in Tape. Appears only if the field has a view. | `5` |
| `config.settings.referenced_apps[].app` (read-only) | `object` | A short preview of the linked app with `app_id`, `icon`, `name`, `slug`, `record_name`, `workspace_id` and `config`. `external_id` and `item_name` repeat `slug` and `record_name` for older integrations. |  |

Find the view IDs with [Retrieve views for an app](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/app#retrieve-views-for-an-app). Create and change views with the [view endpoints](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/view) or in Tape.

Find the workspace ID with [Retrieve workspaces](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/workspace#retrieve-workspaces).

**General behavior**

-   Each object in `referenced_apps` needs an `app_id`. `view_id` is optional and must be a number.
-   Without `primary`, Tape makes the first field of the request the primary field. Here, that's "Belongs to Epic".
-   A new relation field doesn't show its `description` as help text yet (`show_description` is `false`). To show it, send the `description` again in a field update.

**Requirements:** `apps:edit`, a workspace role that may edit apps in the workspace, and at least **Can view** access to the linked apps. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token or a user API key.

**Errors**

-   A mix of linked apps with and without `view_id` in `referenced_apps` returns `400` with the message `View with id undefined does not exist`. If one linked app has a `view_id`, every linked app needs one.

# Status field

> Use a status field to track whether a record, like a task or a deal, is still open or done.

Use a status field to track whether a record, like a task or a deal, is still open or done.

Tape has one status field type: `status` is the **Status** field. It works like a `single_category` field with one difference: every option says whether it means completed. Set this with `means_completed`.

-   An option with `"means_completed": true` marks the record as done. Typical labels: "Done", "Discarded", "Duplicate".
-   An option with `"means_completed": false` marks the record as open. Typical labels: "Open", "In Progress", "Blocked".

A status value holds one option. An app has at most one status field, and every status field is required.

In Tape, the field settings show these options as **Completed** and **Incomplete**. Tape uses them for **Focus**: a record with an incomplete status can appear in the Focus of its users, a record with a completed status leaves it. Learn more about [Focus](https://help.tapeapp.com/en/articles/6394049-focus).

![Settings of a Status field with its options, some of them marked Completed](https://developers.tapeapp.com/assets/images/status-field-settings-e227f6a4209e98ed51f0df87cfcdddb1.png)

![Focus in Tape with an open record from a database app with a status field](https://developers.tapeapp.com/assets/images/focus-open-record-93b322a2de14433157490a8c631c225a.png)

A status field has the [common field properties](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/overview#common-properties) and `settings` with its options and layout. To read and set the status of a record, see [Status field value](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field-value/status).

*Status field object*

```json
{
  "field_id": 1,
  "external_id": "status",
  "slug": "status",
  "label": "Status",
  "type": "category",
  "field_type": "status",
  "config": {
    "label": "Status",
    "slug": "status",
    "external_id": "status",
    "description": "The current status of the task.",
    "show_description": true,
    "required": true,
    "always_hidden": false,
    "hidden_if_empty": false,
    "primary": true,
    "settings": {
      "multiple": false,
      "layout": "dropdown",
      "options": [
        { "id": 1, "text": "Open", "color": "0077DE", "means_completed": false },
        { "id": 2, "text": "In Progress", "color": "DEA700", "means_completed": false },
        { "id": 3, "text": "Done", "color": "00866A", "means_completed": true }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

| Property | Type | Description | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `string` | `"category"`. A status field has the same `type` as a category field. | `"category"` |
| `field_type` | `string` | `"status"`. | `"status"` |
| `config.required` | `boolean` | `true` for every status field. | `true` |
| `config.settings.multiple` (read-only) | `boolean` | `false` for every status field. | `false` |
| `config.settings.layout` | `string` | Older layout setting: `"dropdown"`, `"list"` or `"inline"` (default). Tape stores and returns the value, but it doesn't change how the options look. Set that in the record layout of the app. | `"dropdown"` |
| `config.settings.options` | `array` | The options of the field, in their order. |  |
| `config.settings.options[].id` | `number` | ID of the option. Use it to change the option or to select it in a record. | `2` |
| `config.settings.options[].text` | `string` | Label of the option. Required for every option you send. | `"In Progress"` |
| `config.settings.options[].means_completed` | `boolean` | Whether the option marks the record as done. Required for every option you send. | `false` |
| `config.settings.options[].color` | `string` | Color of the option. Send a name or a hex value, responses return a hex value without `#`. See [Option colors](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/category#option-colors). | `"DEA700"` |
| `config.settings.options_to_delete` (write-only) | `array` | App update only. The IDs of the options to delete. | `[{ "id": 4 }]` |

```shell
        "field_type": "status",

            "options": [
              { "text": "Open", "color": "blue", "means_completed": false },
              { "text": "In Progress", "color": "yellow", "means_completed": false },
              { "text": "Done", "color": "green", "means_completed": true }
```

**JSON**

```json
  "workspace_id": 1,
  "name": "Tasks",

      "field_type": "status",
      "config": {
        "label": "Status",
        "description": "The current status of the task.",
        "required": true,
        "settings": {
          "options": [
            { "text": "Open", "color": "blue", "means_completed": false },
            { "text": "In Progress", "color": "yellow", "means_completed": false },
            { "text": "Done", "color": "green", "means_completed": true }
```

*Response*

```json
{
  "app_id": 1,
  "workspace_id": 1,
  "slug": "tasks",
  "external_id": "tasks",
  "name": "Tasks",
  "record_name": "Task",
  "item_name": "Task",
  "type": "database",
  "config": {
    "item_name": "Task",
    "name": "Tasks"
  },
  "fields": [
    {
      "field_id": 1,
      "external_id": "status",
      "slug": "status",
      "label": "Status",
      "type": "category",
      "field_type": "status",
      "config": {
        "label": "Status",
        "slug": "status",
        "external_id": "status",

        "show_description": false,

        "always_hidden": false,
        "hidden_if_empty": false,
```

The example creates a tasks app in the workspace with ID `1`. The app gets a `status` field "Status" with two open options and one completed option. The example leaves out other fields of a tasks app, like "Title" or "Due date".

Find the workspace ID with [Retrieve workspaces](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/workspace#retrieve-workspaces).

**General behavior**

-   Tape keeps the order of `options` from the request.
-   Without `required`, Tape sets it to `true`.
-   Without `layout`, a new field uses `"inline"`.
-   Without `color`, a new option is gray (`6E7174`).
-   Without `primary`, Tape makes the first field of the request the primary field. Here, that's "Status".
-   A new status field doesn't show its `description` as help text (`show_description` is `false`).

**Requirements:** `apps:edit`, and a workspace role that may edit apps in the workspace. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token or a user API key.

**Errors**

-   An option without `text` or `means_completed` returns `400`.
-   `"required": false` returns `400` with the message `Status fields must be required`.
-   A field without an option with `"means_completed": true` returns `400` with the message `At least one option must have means_completed = true`. Without an option with `"means_completed": false`, the message reads `At least one option must have means_completed = false`.
-   A second status field in the app returns `400` with the message `Only one status field is allowed per app`.

## App update

Use the [update app endpoint](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/app#update-an-app) to create a status field in an app or to change the existing one.

`PUT https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/app/{appId}`

**cURL**

*Request*

```shell

curl -X PUT https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/app/1 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TAPE_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{
    "fields": [
      {
        "field_id": 1,
        "config": {
          "label": "Status",
          "description": "The current status of the task.",
          "settings": {
            "options": [
              { "id": 1, "text": "Open", "color": "blue", "means_completed": false },
              { "id": 2, "text": "In Progress", "color": "yellow", "means_completed": false },
              { "id": 3, "text": "Done", "color": "green", "means_completed": true },
              { "text": "Discarded", "color": "red", "means_completed": true }
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  }'
```

**JSON**

*Request*

```json
{
  "fields": [
    {
      "field_id": 1,
      "config": {
        "label": "Status",
        "description": "The current status of the task.",
        "settings": {
          "options": [
            { "id": 1, "text": "Open", "color": "blue", "means_completed": false },
            { "id": 2, "text": "In Progress", "color": "yellow", "means_completed": false },
            { "id": 3, "text": "Done", "color": "green", "means_completed": true },
            { "text": "Discarded", "color": "red", "means_completed": true }
          ]
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

*Response*

```json
{
  "app_id": 1,
  "workspace_id": 1,
  "slug": "tasks",
  "external_id": "tasks",
  "name": "Tasks",
  "record_name": "Task",
  "item_name": "Task",
  "type": "database",
  "config": {
    "item_name": "Task",
    "name": "Tasks"
  },
  "fields": [
    {
      "field_id": 1,
      "external_id": "status",
      "slug": "status",
      "label": "Status",
      "type": "category",
      "field_type": "status",
      "config": {
        "label": "Status",
        "slug": "status",
        "external_id": "status",
        "description": "The current status of the task.",
        "show_description": false,
        "required": true,
        "always_hidden": false,
        "hidden_if_empty": false,
        "primary": true,
        "settings": {
          "multiple": false,
          "layout": "inline",
          "options": [
            { "id": 1, "text": "Open", "color": "0077DE", "means_completed": false },
            { "id": 2, "text": "In Progress", "color": "DEA700", "means_completed": false },
            { "id": 3, "text": "Done", "color": "00866A", "means_completed": true },
            { "id": 4, "text": "Discarded", "color": "FE001A", "means_completed": true }
          ]
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

The example adds the completed option "Discarded" to the "Status" field (ID `1`) of the tasks app.

Find the app ID and the field IDs in the [Developer view of the app](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/app#find-app-and-field-ids). Find the option IDs in `config.settings.options` of the field, for example with [Retrieve a single app](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/app#retrieve-a-single-app).

**General behavior**

-   An option with `id` changes that option. To rename it, send its `id` with the new `text` and its `means_completed`. An option without `id` creates a new option.
-   Options you leave out of `options` stay unchanged. To set a new order, send all existing options in that order.
-   An option you send without the other options moves to the end of the list, also when you only rename it. To keep the order, send all options in the order you want.
-   To delete options, list their IDs in `settings.options_to_delete`, for example `"options_to_delete": [{ "id": 4 }]`. Tape also accepts plain IDs: `[4]`. An option that is also in `options` stays.
-   When you delete an option, Tape moves its records to the first option with the same `means_completed` value. If you delete "Open" here, its records move to "In Progress".
-   Without `layout`, the field keeps its layout.
-   Send `always_hidden`, `hidden_if_empty` and `description` with every field you update. Tape sets left-out switches to `false`. `show_description` stays as it is. See [Create and update fields](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/overview#create-and-update-fields).
-   Fields that aren't in the request stay unchanged.

**Requirements:** `apps:edit`, and **Full access** to the app. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token or a user API key.

**Errors**

-   Every field you update needs `config.label`, even if the label stays the same. Without it, Tape rejects the request with `400` and `input_validation`. The message reads, for example, `Invalid input: data/fields/0/config must have required property 'label'`.
-   `"required": false` returns `400` with the message `Status fields must be required`.
-   A change that leaves no option with `"means_completed": true` or none with `"means_completed": false` returns `400` with the message `At least one option must have means_completed = true` or `At least one option must have means_completed = false`.
-   A second status field in the app returns `400`.
-   An option ID in `options` or `options_to_delete` that doesn't belong to the field returns `400`.

# Text field

> Use a text field to store a name, a note or any other text in a record.

Use a text field to store a name, a note or any other text in a record.

Tape has two text field types:

-   `single_text` is the **Single line text** field. It holds plain text with up to 500 characters.
-   `multi_text` is the **Multi line text** field. It holds rich text (HTML) with up to 150000 characters.

A text field has the [common field properties](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/overview#common-properties) and read-only `settings`. To read and write the text of a record, see [Text field value](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field-value/text).

*Text field object*

```json
{
  "field_id": 2,
  "external_id": "notes",
  "slug": "notes",
  "label": "Notes",
  "type": "text",
  "field_type": "multi_text",
  "config": {
    "label": "Notes",
    "slug": "notes",
    "external_id": "notes",
    "description": "Notes about the contact.",
    "show_description": true,
    "required": false,
    "always_hidden": false,
    "hidden_if_empty": false,
    "primary": false,
    "settings": {
      "formatted": true,
      "format": "html"
    }
  }
}
```

| Property | Type | Description | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `string` | `"text"` for both text field types. | `"text"` |
| `field_type` | `string` | `"single_text"` or `"multi_text"`. | `"multi_text"` |
| `config.settings.formatted` (read-only) | `boolean` | `false` for `single_text`, `true` for `multi_text`. | `true` |
| `config.settings.format` (read-only) | `string` | Text format of the field. `"plain"` for `single_text`. `"html"`, `"plain"` or `"code"` for `multi_text`, depending on the text format chosen in Tape. | `"html"` |

You can't set `settings` through the API. Choose the text format of a `multi_text` field in Tape.

# Unique ID field

> Use a unique ID field to give every record of a database app a readable ID, like DEAL-0012.

Use a unique ID field to give every record of a database app a readable ID, like `DEAL-0012`.

Tape has one unique ID field type: `unique_id` is the **Unique ID** field. Tape fills it and counts up per database app: the first record gets `1`, the second `2`, and so on. You can't set the value yourself.

The number is the record's `app_record_id`, which every record returns, with or without a **Unique ID** field. The field adds a prefix, a suffix and leading zeros to it.

A unique ID field has the [common field properties](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/overview#common-properties) and the `settings` below. To read the unique ID of a record, see [Field value](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field-value/overview#field-type).

*Unique ID field object*

```json
{
  "field_id": 2,
  "external_id": "deal_id",
  "slug": "deal_id",
  "label": "Deal ID",
  "type": "unique_id",
  "field_type": "unique_id",
  "config": {
    "label": "Deal ID",
    "slug": "deal_id",
    "external_id": "deal_id",
    "description": "The ID of the deal.",
    "show_description": true,
    "required": false,
    "always_hidden": false,
    "hidden_if_empty": false,
    "primary": false,
    "settings": {
      "prefix": "DEAL-",
      "min_digits": 4,
      "unit_location": "prefix",
      "unit_label": "DEAL-",
      "unit": "DEAL-"
    }
  }
}
```

| Property | Type | Description | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `string` | `"unique_id"`. | `"unique_id"` |
| `field_type` | `string` | `"unique_id"`. | `"unique_id"` |
| `config.settings.min_digits` | `number` | Minimum number of digits, from 1 to 12. Tape fills shorter numbers with leading zeros. A new field without `min_digits` gets `1`. | `4` |
| `config.settings.prefix` | `string` | Text in front of the number, for example `"DEAL-"` for deals or `"TASK-"` for tasks. | `"DEAL-"` |
| `config.settings.suffix` | `string` | Text after the number. | `"-EU"` |
| `config.settings.unit_location` | `string` | Which labels Tape shows: `"prefix"`, `"suffix"` or `"prefix_and_suffix"`. | `"prefix"` |
| `config.settings.unit` | `string` | The prefix, or the suffix if `unit_location` is `"suffix"`. Kept for compatibility with number fields. | `"DEAL-"` |
| `config.settings.unit_label` (read-only) | `string` | Same as `unit`, kept for backwards compatibility. | `"DEAL-"` |

Record responses return the value of a unique ID field like other field values, for example `{ "value": 12, "formatted": "DEAL-0012" }`. `value` is the number without prefix and suffix, `formatted` is the ID as Tape shows it.

**General behavior**

-   Without `primary`, Tape makes the first field of the request the primary field. It skips `unique_id` fields when the request has fields of other types.
-   Without `unit_location`, Tape sets it from the labels you send: `"prefix"` for a prefix, `"suffix"` for a suffix, `"prefix_and_suffix"` for both.
-   A new unique ID field doesn't show its `description` as help text yet (`show_description` is `false`). To show it, send the `description` again in a field update.

**Requirements:** `apps:edit`, and a workspace role that may edit apps in the workspace. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token or a user API key.

**Errors**

-   `min_digits` above 12 returns `400`.

```json
  "external_id": "deals",
  "name": "Deals",
  "record_name": "Deal",
  "item_name": "Deal",
  "type": "database",
  "config": {
    "item_name": "Deal",
    "name": "Deals"
  },
  "fields": [
    {
      "field_id": 1,
      "external_id": "deal_name",
      "slug": "deal_name",
      "label": "Deal Name",
      "type": "text",
      "field_type": "single_text",
      "config": {
        "label": "Deal Name",
        "slug": "deal_name",
        "external_id": "deal_name",
        "description": "The name of the deal.",
        "show_description": true,
        "required": true,
        "always_hidden": false,
        "hidden_if_empty": false,
        "primary": true,
        "settings": {
          "formatted": false,
          "format": "plain"
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "field_id": 2,
      "external_id": "deal_id",
      "slug": "deal_id",
      "label": "Deal ID",
      "type": "unique_id",
      "field_type": "unique_id",
      "config": {
        "label": "Deal ID",
        "slug": "deal_id",
        "external_id": "deal_id",
        "description": "The ID of the deal.",
        "show_description": true,
        "required": false,
        "always_hidden": false,
        "hidden_if_empty": false,
        "primary": false,
        "settings": {
          "prefix": "DEAL-",
          "suffix": "-EU",
          "min_digits": 5,
          "unit_location": "prefix_and_suffix",
          "unit_label": "DEAL-",
          "unit": "DEAL-"
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

The example changes the "Deal ID" field (ID `2`) of the deals app. It sets `min_digits` to `5` and adds the suffix "-EU". The 12th deal then shows as `DEAL-00012-EU`.

Find the app ID and the field IDs in the [Developer view of the app](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/app#find-app-and-field-ids).

**General behavior**

-   A field with `field_id` updates that field. A field without `field_id` creates a new field and needs a `field_type`.
-   Send `prefix` and `suffix` together, even if only one of them changes. Without `unit_location`, Tape sets it from the labels in the request, so a request with only `suffix` shows only the suffix.
-   Without `min_digits`, the minimum number of digits stays the same.
-   Changing the settings changes only how Tape shows the IDs. The numbers of the records stay the same.
-   Send `required`, `always_hidden`, `hidden_if_empty` and `description` with every field you update. Tape sets left-out switches to `false` and hides the help text without `description`. See [Create and update fields](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/overview#create-and-update-fields).
-   Fields that aren't in the request stay unchanged.

**Requirements:** `apps:edit`, and **Full access** to the app. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token or a user API key.

**Errors**

-   Every field you update needs `config.label`, even if the label stays the same. Without it, Tape rejects the request with `400` and `input_validation`. The message reads, for example, `Invalid input: data/fields/0/config must have required property 'label'`.
-   `min_digits` above 12 returns `400`.

# User field

> Use a user field to assign users of your organization to a record.

Use a user field to assign users of your organization to a record.

Tape has two user field types. Both are the **Member** field in Tape:

-   `single_user` holds one user.
-   `multi_user` holds several users.

A user field has the [common field properties](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field/overview#common-properties) and read-only `settings`. To read and write the users of a record, see [User field value](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field-value/user).

*User field object*

```json
{
  "field_id": 2,
  "external_id": "participants",
  "slug": "participants",
  "label": "Participants",
  "type": "contact",
  "field_type": "multi_user",
  "config": {
    "label": "Participants",
    "slug": "participants",
    "external_id": "participants",
    "description": "The participants of the meeting.",
    "show_description": true,
    "required": false,
    "always_hidden": false,
    "hidden_if_empty": false,
    "primary": false,
    "settings": {
      "multiple": true
    }
  }
}
```

| Property | Type | Description | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `string` | `"contact"` for both user field types. | `"contact"` |
| `field_type` | `string` | `"single_user"` or `"multi_user"`. | `"multi_user"` |
| `config.settings.multiple` (read-only) | `boolean` | `false` for `single_user`, `true` for `multi_user`. | `true` |

You can't set `settings` through the API. The field type decides whether the field holds one or several users.

**General behavior**

-   Without `primary`, Tape makes the first field of the request the primary field. Here, that's "Responsible for Note taking".
-   A new user field doesn't show its `description` as help text yet (`show_description` is `false`). To show it, send the `description` again in a field update.

**Requirements:** `apps:edit`, and a workspace role that may edit apps in the workspace. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token or a user API key.

# File

> Use these endpoints to upload files to Tape, so you can attach them to records, comments and emails.

Use these endpoints to upload files to Tape, so you can attach them to records, comments and emails.

A file can be a spreadsheet, an image, a PDF, a video or any other data. Tape identifies each uploaded file by its `file_id`.

> Which capability do I need?
> 
> All upload endpoints need `records:edit`. See [Capabilities](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/capabilities).

> Why does uploading take two steps?
> 
> An upload can fail, for example because the file is too large or the network drops. So that this doesn't break a bigger operation like creating a record, attaching a file takes two steps:
> 
> 1.  Upload the file to Tape. The response contains a file ID.
> 2.  Use the file ID to attach the file to a record, a comment or another resource.
> 
> To attach it to a record, send the file ID as the value of an [attachment field](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field-value/attachment#record-creation), for example `"fields": { "contract": "temporary-file-1" }`. On an existing record, also send the files to keep, because an [update](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/field-value/attachment#record-update) replaces the field's files. Unlike the Podio API, Tape has no separate attach endpoint.

Upload files with the `multipart/form-data` content type. Every uploaded file has a `file_id`, a `name`, a `size` and a `link`.

**General behavior**

-   The `link` URL expires after some hours. After that, you can't download the file through it. Retrieve the record that holds the file again to get a new `link`.
-   Once you attach an uploaded file to a resource, you can retrieve it only through that resource.
-   Tape deletes uploaded files that you don't attach within 24 hours.
-   Upload responses have no [thumbnail](#thumbnails) yet, also not for an image. `thumbnail` is missing or `null` there.

## Upload a file

Use this endpoint to upload one file.

`POST https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/file/upload`

**cURL**

*Request*

```shell
curl https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/file/upload \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TAPE_TOKEN" \
  -F 'file=@./filename.txt'
```

**HTTP**

*Request*

```http
POST /v1/file/upload HTTP/1.1
Host: api.tapeapp.com
Authorization: Bearer $TAPE_TOKEN
Accept: */*
Content-Length: 20
Content-Type: multipart/form-data
```

*Response*

```json
{
  "file_id": "temporary-file-1",
  "name": "filename.txt",
  "size": 20,
  "mimetype": "text/plain",
  "created_on": "2022-01-01 12:00:00",
  "created_on_utc": "2022-01-01 11:00:00",
  "link": "https://s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/tape-attachments/9d43730ffad8d249e3ac313193cd83?Expires=1648134130&Signature=VzrbvlfI35hp4iU7jMa%2BK%2FnutPU%3D"
}
```

Send the file in the form field `file`.

The response has status `201` and is a file object:

> Why is the response an object, not an array?
> 
> The request contained one file. For one file, the response is a single file object. With more than one file, it's an array.

**Requirements:** `records:edit`. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token, a user API key or an automation API key.

**Requirements:** `records:edit`. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token, a user API key or an automation API key.

## Create a signed upload URL

Use this endpoint to get a URL that accepts one upload without your credential.

`POST https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/file/upload/url`

*Request*

```shell
curl -X POST https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/file/upload/url \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TAPE_TOKEN"
```

*Response*

```json
{
  "upload_url": "https://api.tapeapp.com/v1/file/upload/signed?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9...",
  "expires_at": "2022-01-01T12:00:00.000Z",
  "method": "POST",
  "content_type": "multipart/form-data",
  "form_field_name": "file"
}
```

Use it when the client that sends the file can't hold your credential, for example an agent that works through an MCP client.

The example leaves out `max_file_size_bytes` and `max_files_per_request`.

Send the file to `upload_url` as `multipart/form-data`, in the form field `form_field_name`. Don't send an `Authorization` header. The response is the same file object as in [Upload a file](#upload-a-file).

**Key fields**

-   `upload_url`: the URL for the upload. It contains a token and works for one request. A second upload to it returns `400` with `Invalid or expired upload ticket`.
-   `expires_at`: the upload must start before this time, in UTC (ISO 8601).
-   `max_file_size_bytes` and `max_files_per_request`: the upload limits. Read them from the response instead of hard-coding them.

> Can I log or store the URL?
> 
> No. Anyone with the URL can upload one file in your name until it expires. Treat it like a credential.

**Requirements:** `records:edit`. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token, a user API key or an automation API key.

## Thumbnails

Tape tries to create thumbnail images in several sizes for each uploaded file. Use them for profile pictures, file previews and similar places:

-   `small`: JPG, 100px wide and 100px high
-   `medium`: JPG, 200px wide and 200px high
-   `large`: JPG in the original width and height of the image

An example thumbnail object:

```json
{
  "small": "https://s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/tape-thumbnails/def09e9319ca30e9ab2bc13e061982",
  "medium": "https://s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/tape-thumbnails/82f3c2669deca95c16d1ad955734e0",
  "large": "https://s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/tape-thumbnails/f8f105f4daaced0f3f714b5ebb76ae"
}
```

## Upload limits

Tape enforces these limits for all upload endpoints:

| Variable | Limit |
| --- | --- |
| Maximum file size | 100MB |

## Rate limit credits

The credits of an upload depend on the file size, added up over all files of a request. An upload costs at least 2x the credits of a normal request. A file of 50MB costs 3x credits, a file of 100MB costs 4x credits:

```text
Uploading 1KB: 2x credits
Uploading 50MB: 3x credits
Uploading 100MB: 4x credits
Uploading 150MB: 5x credits
Uploading 200MB: 6x credits
Uploading 300MB: 8x credits
...
```

Uploading several files in one request costs fewer credits than uploading each file on its own.

## Validation errors

Tape returns a detailed error message for most failed uploads.

*No file provided validation error*

```json
{
  "status_code": 400,
  "endpoint": "/v1/file/upload",
  "error_code": "validation",
  "error_message": "No file provided to upload endpoint via multipart/form-data field name: 'file'"
}
```

# Filter

> Use filters to choose which records of a database app a request returns.

Use filters to choose which records of a database app a request returns.

The same filter object works in two places:

-   [Retrieve filtered records for an app](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/record#retrieve-filtered-records-for-an-app) (`POST /v1/record/filter/app/{app_id}`) returns the records that match.
-   A [view](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/view) stores filters and shows only the records that match.

Everything on this page applies to both, except the [metadata filters](#record-metadata-filters): a view stores only field filters. [View filters](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/view#filters) lists the rules that apply to views only.

**Requirements:** `records:read` to retrieve filtered records, `apps:edit` and share access to the app to save filters in a view. Works with a personal access token, an OAuth access token or a user API key.

> Coming from the Podio API?
> 
> Send `filters` as an array with one filter object and a `match_type` per field. Use the field ID: the slug (`external_id`) doesn't work here. Several category options go in one filter with `any`. A date range with `from` and `to` becomes `within` with `exact_range` and `end_date`, see [Single date](#single-date). Send `sort_by` (field ID or slug), `sort_desc`, `limit` and `cursor` in the query string, not in the body. There is no `offset`.

## The filter object

Send your filters as an array in `filters`. A record matches only if it matches *every* filter (`AND`). There is no `OR`.

Each *field filter* is a JSON object with these keys:

| Property | Type | Description | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `field_id` | integer or string | ID of the field to filter on. **Required.** The slug (`external_id`) returns a `400`. | `"1"` |
| `field_type` | string | Type of the field, for example `single_text`, `status` or `single_date`. Required for view filters. Optional for filtered records, where `field_id` identifies the field, but send it anyway. | `"single_text"` |
| `type` | string | Legacy data type that goes with the field type, for example `text`, `status` or `date`. **Required.** A filter without it returns a `400`. | `"text"` |
| `match_type` | string | The operator, for example `contains`, `equal` or `before`. Each section below lists the operators a field type accepts. | `"contains"` |
| `values` | array | The operands, as `{ "value": … }` objects. Leave it out for `empty` and `not_empty`. | `[{ "value": "John" }]` |

Some field types accept more optional keys, for example for relative dates, weekdays, the "@me" flag or task list entries. See [Operand keys](#operand-keys).

This example matches all records whose field `1` contains the text `"John"` *and* whose status field `2` is set to option `123`:

**JSON**

*Combined filter*

```json
{
  "filters": [
    {
      "field_id": "1",
      "field_type": "single_text",
      "match_type": "contains",
      "values": [{ "value": "John" }],
      "type": "text"
    },
    {
      "field_id": "2",
      "field_type": "status",
      "match_type": "equal",
      "values": [{ "value": 123 }],
      "type": "status"
    }
  ]
}
```

Send this body to `POST /v1/record/filter/app/{app_id}`. Every field in a record or in [Retrieve a single app](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/resource/app#retrieve-a-single-app) carries its `field_id` and `field_type`. Category and status fields list their option IDs there, in `config.settings.options`.

Sort and page in the query string with `sort_by`, `sort_desc`, `limit` and `cursor`, see [Pagination](https://developers.tapeapp.com/docs/api/pagination). To filter by creation date, last change or record number without a field, use the [metadata filters](#record-metadata-filters).

## Single text

Use this filter for **Single line text** fields (`single_text`).

**JSON**

*Single text filter*

```json
{
  "filters": [
    {
      "field_id": "1",
      "field_type": "single_text",
      "match_type": "contains",
      "values": [{ "value": "John" }],
      "type": "text"
    }
  ]
}
```

**General behavior**

-   `contains`, `not_contains`, `starts_with` and `ends_with` ignore case.
-   `equal` and `not_equal` are exact matches and case-sensitive.
-   Every operator trims leading and trailing whitespace from the match value.
-   `empty` and `not_empty` take no `values`.

**Match types**

| Match type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `equal` | Matches all records whose field value is equal to the match value. |
| `not_equal` | Matches all records whose field value is not equal to the match value. |
| `contains` | Matches all records whose field value contains the match value. |
| `not_contains` | Matches all records whose field value does not contain the match value. |
| `starts_with` | Matches all records whose field value starts with the match value. |
| `ends_with` | Matches all records whose field value ends with the match value. |
| `empty` | Matches all records whose field value is empty. |
| `not_empty` | Matches all records whose field value is not empty. |

## Multi text

*Multi text filter*

```json
  "filters": [

      "field_id": "1",

      "match_type": "contains",
```
